name: To Chiji
source:
The Governor of Tokyo, who announces a blockade around Shibuya following a bioterrorism threat.

The Governor is portrayed by [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hirokazu_Hamamura]Hirokazu Hanamura[/url] via a special appearance.
